about: ACK acknowledgments modeled on a sample: one message (MSH with its MSA and ERR) per member written, taken in turn from the sample's messages. An acknowledgment names no patient: only its control id is each message's own, and every other value is the sample's unless a config names it.
subject: members

message.about: The segments every ACK has (HL7 2.5.1): the acknowledgment itself is the MSA.

units.name: member
units.missing: The sample has no MSH: no message to model acknowledgments on.

derive.about: MSH-10, the message control id, is each message's own.
